operations.AnalyticsSummary: Returns one aggregate bucket over a half-open range. An omitted range defaults to recent data. Reported ratings and heuristic state durations are distinct fields.
operations.AnalyticsStatistics: Groups observed metrics by calendar day, ISO week or month in the requested IANA zone. Each bucket exposes UTC boundaries, including daylight-saving transitions.
operations.AnalyticsResearch: Returns paged per-session observed metrics, estimated state durations and self-reports. A missing rating remains null.
operations.AuthRegister: Creates a new account with a case-insensitively unique normalized email. The password is hashed and no tokens are issued. A duplicate email returns 409.
operations.AuthLogin: Validates credentials and returns an opaque access/refresh pair with Cache-Control: no-store. Invalid credentials return 401 without revealing which credential failed.
operations.AuthRefresh: Consumes the previous refresh token and returns a replacement pair. Serialize refresh requests per client, and discard the old access and refresh tokens after rotation.
operations.AuthLogout: Revokes the current login family. Set stopCamera=true to revoke account-wide camera consent as well; ordinary logout keeps the saved consent. The 204 response has no body.
operations.AuthMe: Returns profile attributes for the account associated with the presented token, including the account email.
operations.AuthRename: Changes the current account display name. The account ID and email remain unchanged.
operations.AuthChangePassword: Requires the current password and a new password. Revokes account logins on success; sign in again. The 204 response has no body.
operations.PrivacyGet: Returns stored consent separately for desktop aggregates and camera aggregates. Vision experiment selection is independent of consent to capture.
operations.PrivacyUpdate: Updates only non-null flags. Consent applies to server ingestion; the Windows Agent still needs local opt-in and camera access.
operations.PrivacyExport: Returns a small private account snapshot and relative links to pageable work profiles and sessions. Follow their pagination to build a full export. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store.
operations.PrivacyDeleteAccount: Verifies the current password before removing the authenticated account and its owned records. A successful 204 has no body; discard local tokens.
operations.ResearchUpload: Accepts a batch of desktop or camera-only windows. Persist one unique clientEventId for each window; an identical retry is counted as a duplicate and changed data for that ID yields 409. Consent and interval boundaries are checked separately for each stream.
operations.ResearchActivity: Returns chronological desktop aggregate windows. Camera-only measurements are available from the separate vision resource.
operations.ResearchEstimates: Returns persisted heuristic state intervals and rule versions derived from desktop windows. The timeline is an estimate rather than a ground-truth concentration label.
operations.ResearchCurrent: Returns the current session state and most recent available estimate. For an active session with the experiment enabled and consent present, an eligible camera overlap can influence the returned estimate.
operations.ResearchVision: Returns totals of coarse camera observations and an optional comparison between baseline and experimental rules. A missing comparison or zero observations does not imply absence.
operations.ResearchTimeline: Combines session time boundaries and goals with a chronological page of activity and estimate references. A client may follow the dedicated activity and estimate feeds for details.
operations.SessionsCreate: Starts in Planned with no working time. Supply a target duration in seconds, optional initial goals and an optional work profile owned by the account.
operations.SessionsList: Filters owned sessions with one-based offset pagination. Results sort by effective start or creation time and use the session ID as a deterministic tie breaker.
operations.SessionsGet: Returns an owned session and its computed durations, goals and any completion ratings. A missing or foreign session is represented as 404.
operations.SessionsStart: Transitions Planned to Active and assigns the server-side start timestamp. A repeated request on an active session returns 409.
operations.SessionsPause: Transitions Active to Paused and opens a single pause interval. A duplicate pause or a pause in another state returns 409.
operations.SessionsResume: Closes the current pause and moves Paused to Active. Resume without an open pause returns 409.
operations.SessionsCancel: Transitions an eligible unfinished session to Cancelled and closes an open pause if needed. A completed or already cancelled session cannot be cancelled again.
operations.SessionsComplete: Finishes an active or paused session. Required 1–5 ratings, an optional reflection and outcomes for owned session goals are applied in one transaction.
operations.SessionsListGoals: Returns the goals attached to the addressed session. Ownership is checked before reading even if there are no goals.
operations.SessionsGetGoal: Looks up the goal only within the addressed owned session. An existing goal under another session is treated as missing.
operations.SessionsAddGoal: Adds a goal while the session is Planned. The created goal has Pending status and the Location response header identifies the goal resource.
operations.SessionsUpdateGoal: Edits descriptions in Planned or updates the outcome after work starts. Send only supplied changes; changes inconsistent with the current session state return 409.
operations.SessionsDeleteGoal: Removes a goal only from a Planned session. Success returns 204 with no body.
operations.SettingsGetPomodoro: Returns the account's saved schedule. The default schedule uses 25 minutes of focus, 5 minutes for a short break, 15 for a long break and four intervals.
operations.SettingsSetPomodoro: Replaces the entire schedule. Send all four duration and interval entries; the response contains the values stored by the API.
operations.SettingsGetAvatar: Returns saved settings or the default OnlyWhenNeeded visibility, Balanced intensity and no explicit avatar ID.
operations.SettingsSetAvatar: Replaces the avatar preferences for the account. These settings guide the desktop player and do not control collection consent.
operations.SettingsGetProfiles: Lists owned work profiles, each with its configured process rules. Use the returned pagination metadata to traverse the collection.
operations.SettingsGetProfile: Returns one owned profile and its normalized process rule names. A missing or foreign profile returns 404.
operations.SettingsCreateProfile: Creates a work profile and an optional list of process rules. Duplicate normalized process identifiers are invalid.
operations.SettingsReplaceProfile: Replaces settings and the complete set of rules for the addressed profile. Omitted rules are interpreted as an empty replacement.
operations.SettingsDeleteProfile: Deletes an owned profile if it is unreferenced. A session reference causes 409. The successful 204 response has no body.

parameters.id: UUID of the addressed session. The account must own it.
parameters.profileId: UUID of the addressed work profile, owned by the authenticated account.
parameters.goalId: UUID of a goal under the addressed session.
parameters.From: Inclusive ISO 8601 lower bound with UTC offset. Omit to use the endpoint default.
parameters.To: Exclusive ISO 8601 upper bound with UTC offset. If supplied with From, To must be later.
parameters.TimeZone: IANA reporting time zone, such as Europe/Kyiv or UTC. The default is UTC.
parameters.Period: Calendar grouping for statistics. Day, Week (ISO week beginning Monday), or Month.
parameters.Status: Optional exact session state. Planned, Active, Paused, Completed or Cancelled.
parameters.Sort: Chronological asc or desc order, with desc as the default.
parameters.Page: One-based page number from 1 to 100,000. Default 1.
parameters.PageSize: Requested page size. Default 25; the default server maximum is 100 and can be configured up to 500.
parameters.stopCamera: When true, withdraws account-wide camera consent before revoking the current login. Defaults to false.

400.description: Correct malformed JSON, invalid field values or parameters. In production use HTTPS.

401.description: Log in again or use a current token. When changing credentials, verify the supplied password.

403.description: Enable consent for the corresponding desktop or camera stream before retrying.

404.description: Check the addressed resource and account. Foreign resources are intentionally indistinguishable from missing ones.

409.description: Read the latest resource state, fix the conflicting transition or resend the identical event payload.

413.description: Reduce the batch payload before retrying.

422.description: Correct the observation timestamps relative to the session, consent, pause and upload window.

429.description: Wait for the Retry-After interval before resending.

500.description: Retry later and give the request correlation ID to support if the failure persists.

fields.expiresIn: Access token lifetime in seconds from issuance.
fields.refreshToken: Opaque renewal credential. Replace both tokens after successful renewal.
